name: Movement reservation
summary: Schedule an ordered route, optionally setting speed, altitude or depth for each leg. Repeating routes can start after a one-time approach.
requirements: Requires Data for AI access to own units and movement plans. The target must be controllable and mobile; aircraft must be airborne. Settings must be among the target's available options. The first reservation update may switch a follower to independent action.
proposal_followers: Formation followers will move with the leader.
